changes: Expanded the PC from 14 to 41 boxes — 1,230 places to keep Pokémon, enough for the entire Pokédex.
Changed the save format to fit those boxes. Convert your existing save with the Save Converter on this website before you play; the game will not save over an unconverted save.
Made room for the bigger PC by no longer storing ribbons on Pokémon kept in a box. A stored Pokémon keeps its Champion Ribbon, and loses any contest ribbons it had won.
Pokémon also come out of the PC fully healed and without contest condition. Contests themselves are unchanged, and your contest wins are still recorded.
Recorded battles are no longer saved.
Fixed the Egg Move Tutor in Verdanturf: it now lists your Pokémon's Egg Moves and takes a Pearl only after a move is learned.
Only catching a pre-Elite Four legendary uses up your pick; knocked-out or fled legendaries return when you re-enter the area.
After becoming Champion, every uncaught pre-Elite Four legendary returns and stays until caught.
Added Regirock, Regice and Registeel to the pre-Elite Four legendaries.
Removed the extra level 50 Latios/Latias encounter from the Southern Island sign.
Every HM in the bag now appears in the party menu wherever it can be used, which fixes the Registeel door.
Fixed remaining out-of-sprite crashes in grass, rain and other busy overworld scenes.
Restored modern HMs for Surf and Fly: having HM03 or HM02 in the bag is enough, as in 1.0.1.
Made Battle Style default to Set, locked to Set in Nuzlocke mode and switchable in Options in Standard mode.
Catching Mew now uses up the pre-Elite Four legendary pick, and legendaries no longer respawn after Champion rematches.
Zapdos now disappears immediately after its battle.
Gave each Granite Cave item ball its own pickup flag so Steelixite and Sablenite can no longer be missed.
Re-enabled the developer menu: hold Select and press Start in the overworld.
Prevented rare black-screen crashes while running through grass in areas with many on-screen effects.
Awarded the National Pokédex alongside the regular Pokédex and upgraded existing saves automatically.
Restored the reusable Candy Jar so it instantly raises a Pokémon to the current badge-based level cap.
Restored the 1.0.1 level-cap rules for battle experience, Rare Candies, and daycare growth.
Fixed event tickets so all four special-island ferry destinations unlock for new and existing saves.
Corrected Pokémon types shown throughout the documentation.
Increased the base Shiny rate from 1 in 8,192 to 1 in 512.
Upgraded the game engine to pokeemerald-expansion 1.16.3 and enabled follower Pokémon.
Made every regular Pokémon and regional form obtainable, with remaining special cases added to the Bean Shop.
Added a postgame Legendary Lottery Island and dozens of Mega Stones to discover across Hoenn.
Reworked all eight Trick House puzzles with 32 region-themed Elite Four cameos, matching sprites, music, and dialogue.
Added new Ace Trainer boss battles and postgame challengers around Hoenn.
Fixed key progression issues involving starters, time-based evolutions, and Nuzlocke catches.
Published the first official release of Pokémon Black Pearl Emerald.
Introduced a reworked Emerald adventure with custom trainer teams, sprites, dialogue, maps, and music.
Added expanded Pokémon content and modern battle mechanics through pokeemerald-expansion 1.8.6.
Added the Bean Shop, Lilycove event-ticket ferry, and expanded legendary encounters.
Improved egg and daycare behavior and polished graphics throughout the game.
